statement: Linux v6.12 decodes four packed 12-bit stick positions from the first eight extension bytes, offsets their nominal center and flips vertical axes, then applies optional first-report center correction when close enough to neutral. It exposes a pro_calib sysfs recalibration interface.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer-side decoding and synthetic calibration; no reference-device EEPROM values or true unit offsets.
